legalPage.title: Copyright and sheet music usage
legalPage.subtitle: By using MaestroSync you agree to the following terms regarding sheet music and copyrighted material.
legalPage.s1Body1: MaestroSync is a technological tool for reading, analyzing, and synchronizing sheet music during rehearsals and performances. The platform does not create, sell, distribute, or license musical works or sheet music editions.
legalPage.s2Body1: All content (PDF, images, MusicXML, or other files) that a user uploads, stores, shares, or uses in MaestroSync is their sole responsibility.
legalPage.s2Body2: The user represents and warrants that they own the rights, or hold the necessary licenses, permissions, or authorizations (or that the work is in the public domain in their jurisdiction) to upload, display, and share such content with other users.
legalPage.s2Body3: Modern editions, arrangements, and transcriptions of public domain works may be independently protected. Verifying this is the user's responsibility.
legalPage.s3Body1: MaestroSync does not pre-screen user-uploaded content or guarantee its legality. To the maximum extent permitted by law, MaestroSync and its owners are released from any claim, damage, or liability arising from users' uploading, use, or distribution of copyrighted material.
legalPage.s3Body2: The user agrees to indemnify and hold MaestroSync harmless against third-party claims arising from content they have uploaded or shared.
legalPage.s4Body1: Features for sharing scores and settings between users are offered solely to facilitate ensemble work. Sharing copyrighted material without authorization from the rights holder may constitute infringement.
legalPage.s5Body1: If you are a rights holder and believe content infringes your rights, you may request its review and removal. MaestroSync may remove content and suspend accounts of users who repeatedly infringe third-party rights.
